_help: Global last-minute corrections for every pickup / placement in competition and task tests. Teaching ignores this file.
All values are millimetres, between -100 and 100. Zero leaves calibration unchanged.
forward_mm: positive = away from robot, negative = toward robot (base X).
right_mm: positive = robot-right, negative = robot-left (minus base Y).
down_mm: positive = deeper grasp/release, negative = higher. Hover clearance stays unchanged; XY follows the calibrated surface.
Pickup and placement corrections are independent, added AFTER visual centering. Returning a pickup to its source uses the pickup correction.
Edit between runs. Each run reads this file once; edits take effect on the next run. Reset all six numbers to zero to remove corrections.
